name: Kessa
found: The Marsh Edge, wading with a jar.
appearance: Stained fingers, mud to the thigh, a leech-jar.
does_not_want: Questions about what she sees out there.
dreams: To die in the marsh and go back to the mud.
dm_notes: She sees lizard-men walk the marsh edge at night, keeping the compact's line. She stays silent because the compact is unspoken.
